svg.title: Sunset Lookout Utila: gentler walking sections with short stair flights
svg.desc: Constructed-route concept, not ground-following. Walking sections are designed at approximately 9.1 percent, with nine flights of eight stairs and eighteen level landings. Model terrain comparison reveals substantial earthworks may be needed. Station labels appear approximately every three metres.

g.text: Gentler walks, short steps, level pauses
Designed floor gradients, not natural-ground slopes • Longer lower traverse; shorter upper traverses
This does NOT follow raw ground.
Rock sizes and tree root zones
Station tags: horizontal route distance every ~3 m + local walking grade, 0% landing, or stair flight ID.
Survey positions/boundary to scale; rock envelopes are hypothetical 10 ft tests. Up is not north.
No safety / structural / geotechnical certification. Grade-controlled geometry is not proof of construction feasibility.
